title: Texas man loses $105,000 property claim after failing to trace inheritance in divorce case
summary_full: A Texas appellate court has confirmed a lower court's decision regarding the divorce property division between Julian and Alice Devon Poole. Julian claimed certain assets as his separate property, including his inheritance and savings. However, the court found he failed to substantiate his claims adequately, leading to a ruling that mandates an equal division of marital assets between the spouses, thus upholding the trial court's verdict.
